name: Hürtgenwald (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green, white and green in the proportions 1:4:1, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Hürtgenwald (a yellow pall on green).
history: By deed of the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia of 8 December 1975 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a flag; the banner is green-white-green 1:4:1 striped lengthwise with the arms shifted slightly above the centre.

features.role: Hürtgenwald arms — yellow pall on green
